newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian bourse hits new high on active trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian bourse hits new high on active trade.

text.p: VILNIUS, Jan 16 (Reter) - Lithuania's bourse maintained its bull run and closed at a new high on Thursday, dealers said.
Overall central market volume was 3.3 million litas and the group A index rose by 376.55 points to reach a new high of 2,913.96.
But dealers cautioned that the rise was probably short-term.
"Everybody knows that such a leap in prices will not last long, two or three weeks at the most. The prices are nearing their value limit," one dealer said.
Ukio Bank's price soared to 45.61 litas from 38.01 litas and 446,704 litas worth of shares changed hands.
Normal market leader Vilnius Bank rose to 260 litas from 252 on trade of 260,000 litas.
Birzai dairy saw its share price rise to 11.40 litas from 9.50 litas on trade worth 227,163 litas.
Rokiskis cheese maker rose to 37.32 from 31.10 though no deals were registered.
Williams de Broe announced earlier on Thursday that it had acquired a 14 percent stake in the cheese factory.
In block trading Rokiskis saw 249,000 litas worth of its shares traded at 24.90 litas.
Bloc trades totaled 3.67 million litas on Thursday, led by Hermis bank.
It registered business of almost 1.2 million litas at a price of 237 litas.
Volume on the secondary T-bill market was only 175,000 litas.
